versions.name: Camp Warren Levis

features.note: A private, well-stocked lake used for boating and fishing.
Swaim Lodge has a full dining hall and kitchen.
Two lodges: Swaim Lodge (heated, larger) and the more primitive Winter Lodge.
The Council Ring, an outdoor theater.

versions.summary: A 285-acre Greater St. Louis Area Council camp on a private lake north of Alton, Illinois, used for weekend and family camping, with a swimming pool, target-sports ranges, a climbing tower, boating, and hiking trails.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) after a Reddit comment flagged it missing from the map; verified against the council's own property page. Coordinates from the page's Google Maps marker; elevation from the open-meteo DEM. Cross-referenced with the community scout-camp-map project (github.com/jasondaihl/scout-camp-map). July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Added by hand from the Greater St. Louis Area Council property page; camp-finder never captured it (a weekend/family-camping property rather than a resident summer camp). Operational dates and fees are deliberately excluded (they stay on the council site). Features surveyed 2026-08-14 against the council's own property page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). July normals are null pending a WorldClim resample of the new coordinate.
